Name: Delicious in Stardew (New Monster Cooking Recipes)
Author: stinkyvicki
Description:
Are you sick and tired of having tons of random monster loot and no clue what to use it all for? Does your farmer enjoy experimenting in the kitchen? Or maybe you just think the idea of eating monsters is kind of neat!

This mod features a handful of new cooking recipes inspired by the Dungeon Meshi manga, although no prior knowledge of the series is required to enjoy the mod! ﻿

This is my first mod, and I am very excited to share it! If you notice any errors, bugs, or issues, kindly let me know in the comments! In addition, if you have any suggestions for more recipes or potential balance tweaks feel free to comment those as well, thought I can't promise or guarantee their addition in any future updates.

[b]WHAT THIS MOD INCLUDES:[/b]
14 new recipes with custom sprites and a variety of buffs that will hopefully prove useful to any adventurer delving into the mines!
All ingredients are items from the vanilla game.
If you are curious about exactly what recipes this mod adds, check under the spoilers!
[code][spoiler]
-Boiled Stonefish
-Cave Bat Tempura
-Cave Grub Dumplings
-Cheesy Bat Casserole
-Exorcism Sorbet
-Monster Medley Stew
-Prehistoric Omelet
-Roasted Bug
-Rock Crab Hotpot
-Slime Egg Souffle
-Slime Jelly Sandwich
-Slime Torte
-Shadow Coffee
-Slimeade
[/spoiler]
[/code]
[b]
ACQUIRING THE RECIPES:
[/b]
All recipes can be purchased from the Dwarf's shop once the vanilla requirements to unlock the NPC have been met. Once purchased, you can make the recipes using the upgraded farm kitchen or the cookout kit.

[b]TRANSLATIONS:
[/b]
If you want to create a translation for the mod, you are more than welcome to create one and upload it! All I ask is that you let me know in the comments if you are planning to do so. The mod comes with an i18n file to hopefully make any translation work fairly straightforward!

Many thanks to everyone who has created translations for the mod!

[b]FUTURE OF THE MOD:[/b]

While the mod is entirely finished and in a working state, I have been toying with the possibility of future updates because I have been having so much fun with this idea. These possible, entirely hypothetical updates may include things like:

- Specific gift tastes for vanilla NPCs
- More recipes, with a focus on new beverages
-  More variety in the requirements to access recipes (unlocking through skill level, advancement in the mines, etc.)
- Who knows! The future is a mystery to us all
